verdict.rationale: Snowflake runs automations such as Snowpipe, dbt Projects, and dynamic tables, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. dbt Projects is described only as 'develop, deploy, orchestrate, observe', with no mention of version history or rollback. Time Travel restores data and dropped objects, which is an adjacent data-recovery feature, not versioning or rollback of automation definitions.
